**Diagnosis**
The global baseline outlier is `unified.attn.attn.kv_cache_append`: case 0 R0 was 313.885558 us versus R5 0.0143605 us, a 21,857.6x excess. It uses the eager Torch path with indexed K/V writes. The fused `vllm_cuda` backend has no matching B200 profile rows, so using it would require forbidden profiling or an invented value.

The cache-covered actionable target was `unified.draft_topk1`, whose eager Torch R0 was 21.826155 us versus R5 0.152070 us (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`).

Changed `simulator/src/arch/qwen2_dense_sglang_before.rs` to select the warm B200 `triton` backend for `draft_topk1`. Updated the focused arch assertion and stale docs in `simulator/src/arch/qwen2_dense_sglang_common.rs`, `simulator/src/arch/config.rs`, and `simulator/src/arch/build.rs`.
